review_output: {"summary":"The arithmetic checks out. Exact rational coverage, the 90% threshold, ceil-to-ms crossing, window cutoffs, the T-1 boundary, order inclusion, provisional logic and the test expectations are consistent in my review (hand-traced, not executed). One MAJOR remains: the BigInt coverage evaluator can degrade badly with jittered segment durations. Two MINOR items concern a test gap and the pre-verification completion contradiction path.","findings":[{"severity":"MAJOR","area":"performance","file":"src/lib/live-viewing-evidence.ts","issue":"Exact BigInt coverage can become very slow with varied segment durations.","evidence":"add() computes gcd(n,d) on every accumulation, and denominators are wall durations whose lcm grows with jittered 900-1100ms samples. completedAt also rebuilds and sorts BigInt fractions in each of up to 53 binary-search steps, for up to 10000 segments per person.","impact":"One viewer near the cap could take seconds to minutes in the synchronous read path. Cost is multiplied across persons, so a report could stall.","recommended_fix":"Precompute and sort the fractions once. Drop the per-add gcd, since d is already the lcm. Use a common scaled denominator or a Number prefilter with exact BigInt only near the threshold. Short-circuit once coverage reaches the threshold.","required_test":"Benchmark 10000 jittered segments (durations 900-1100ms, mixed overlaps) with a time budget, and assert results are identical to the current exact implementation on randomized inputs.","confidence":0.6},{"severity":"MINOR","area":"tests","file":"src/lib/live-core-metrics-read-model.test.ts","issue":"The read model has no test for fractional slope or clipped exposure feeding the completion reconciliation.","evidence":"The .999 and rational-crossing cases are tested only against firstCompletionTime. Every read-model fixture uses integer or unit slopes, and the clipping test has a unit-slope row that never completes.","impact":"A regression in how verifiedAt, startMs or endMs-1 is passed into firstCompletionTime would be missed. That includes preclipping the slope and reconciling against a rounded durable timestamp.","recommended_fix":"Add read-model tests with a .999-slope segment cut by verification and by T.","required_test":"A 29970ms video, a segment of 29970 media over 30000 wall, verifiedAt 17, durable completion 27017: valid with T=27018. With T=27017 and a durable completion of 27017, the order metric is not computed. Derived completion uses only exposure after verification, so durable pre-verification completion cannot match.","impact":"This is fail-closed rather than wrong, but one such row makes all post-completion order metrics invalid_data for the report.","recommended_fix":"Document that durable first-completion facts must be computed from verified-eligible exposure only. Alternatively, exclude pre-verification completers explicitly under an approved rule.","required_test":"A person with a durable completion before verifiedAt and a later eligible re-watch asserts the documented behavior, either invalid or excluded.","confidence":0.35}]}
